tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List effect categories
tools.description: List every effect category, sub-category and asset library in Effect Studio Pro with item counts.

tools.name: search_presets
tools.title: Search presets
tools.description: Search the Effect Studio Pro catalog of effects, filters, transitions, titles, stickers, templates, stock media and audio by keyword, library or tag.

query.description: Keyword to match against preset names and categories.

library.description: Restrict results to one library: effects, filters, transitions, titles, stickers, templates, stock or audio.

tag.description: Mood tag such as cinematic, vlog, gaming, retro or ai.

tools.name: get_preset
tools.title: Get preset details
tools.description: Get the full technical detail of one Effect Studio Pro preset: its render engine, GPU effect primitive, default parameter values and motion signature.

id.description: Preset id, as returned by search_presets.
